name: r1-pf
summary: Climb round 1 L2-prefetch levers for launcher 08a249da: G13 (DSpark drafter graph + E-phase), G15 (shared w2 post-AR burst), G11a (kv-source compressor weight in the post-MoE AR window). G29 (indexer wq_b AG tail) is built for burst all-gather windows only and refuses itself (logged INACTIVE, no plan change) on 08a249da, where 'ag' is paced. G01 (in-order wo_b) is dropped: superseded by 08a249da WOB_MB=6. One base patch (4 anchors, 16 tagged lines) + one new module; every lever default off, hints only, fail-closed planning.

levers.variant: skeptic best_variant: D5 scope (drafter graph + E-phase) + M5 main_proj; drafter windows paced at PACE_GBPS (125); wq_b moved to the previous paced window (qbprev); drafter WOA window; draft head in the last model AR window; no mHC fn hints (and no Markov-embedding hints); both DSpark graph sets (greedy-sharded included). C6(b) persisting-L2 not built.

built for BURST all-gather windows only (launcher fda6d05a, PACE_KINDS=ar): in-order tail on the indexer-layer qkv_a all-gather windows (rest of the indexer wq_b after the 6 MiB cut), second burst on side stream 1, IDXTAIL_SPLIT CTAs, joined at the post-attention AR. bind() REFUSES it when 'ag' is in PACE_KINDS with PACE_GBPS>0 (08a249da): there the tail would queue on pacer stream 3 between the paced AG window and the promoted paced wo_a+wo_b window and delay the latter ~36 us in each indexer layer. No window arm on 08a249da; re-plan for paced AG needs a trace.

shared-expert w2 (down_proj scales + codes, 1.52 MB/layer) as a burst in a post fork right after the post-attention AR (base after_collective machinery). Variant (a) (cross-step FC1 expert prefetch) not built.

part (a) only: first 2.5 MiB of compressor.fused_wkv_wgate as a paced part appended to the preceding post-MoE AR window (nearest earlier AR; layer 14 skips its Engram AG). Part (b) (graph node priority / join move) not built (outside this kit's file and needs a device test).

DROPPED in the review fix: launcher 08a249da promoted the paced wo_a+wo_b window (WOB_MB=6), so the in-order fallback always refused itself and a valid A/B would need WOB_MB=0 (reverting climb-w1). The code is removed and DSV41_L2_PREFETCH_R1_WOB is no longer a master flag: alone it imports nothing; next to a live lever it is only named as ignored in the bind() log line.
